name: Headroom
tagline: Context compression for agents — library, proxy, and MCP
description: Headroom is a context-compression toolkit for AI agents that shrinks unnecessary context by 60-95% before it hits the model. It ships as a library, a proxy, and an MCP server, so it can be dropped into existing agent workflows without rewriting tooling. By aggressively trimming redundant or low-value context, Headroom lowers token cost and latency while keeping the information the agent actually needs. It is built for the growing reality that long-running agents accumulate context bloat quickly.
highlights: Compresses context by 60-95% before it reaches the model
Available as a library, a proxy, and an MCP server for flexible integration
Drops into existing agent workflows without rewriting tooling
Cuts token cost and latency on long-running agent sessions
curatorNote: Context bloat is the silent tax on every long-running agent session. Headroom tackles it head-on with a 60-95% compression claim and flexible deployment as a library, proxy, or MCP server.
